name: Eye Grab Hook
desc: Grade 80 alloy steel eye grab hook, quenched and tempered for lifting applications with Grade 80 chain. The supporting wing design helps prevent chain link deformation without reducing the working load limit. A narrow hook gap ensures secure chain engagement to minimize slip-off. Each hook is permanently marked with the batch number, size, CE, Grade 80/T8, ABLE, and product code.

specs.label: Material
specs.value: Material is high grade alloy steel (quenched and tempered)

specs.value: Used with alloy chain grade 80 for lifting application
